name: kui-workspace
description: Private workspace for KUI libraries and the Admin showcase application.

scripts.build:layers: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:styles && npm run build:core
scripts.build:lib: npm run typecheck && npm run build:layers && npm run layers:check
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:lib && vite build --config app/admin/vite.config.ts && npm run bundle:check
scripts.pack:layers: npm run build:lib && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @kui/tokens && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @kui/style && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @kui/core
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run source:size && npm run boundaries:check && npm run icons:check && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build:demo && npm run smoke:demo && npm run test:e2e:smoke && npm run test:e2e:a11y
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run pack:check && npm run pack:layers && npm run consumer:check
